entities.name: 1902 La Soufrière Eruption and Early 20th Century
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: La Soufrière erupted catastrophically on May 7–8, 1902 (the same week as Mount Pelée in Martinique), killing approximately 1,600 people — mostly Carib descendants in the northern part of the island. The eruption devastated agriculture and deepened poverty.
